title: Subsidy Commitment Rates in the Workplace Cafe Management Program Tariff Annex
content:
| Rate named in the annex | Figure |
| --- | --- |
| The deep subsidy shortfall rate | 8.00 per cent |
| The partial subsidy shortfall rate | 3.50 per cent |
| The nil subsidy shortfall rate | No subsidy commitment surcharge is taken |
| The large site headcount | 400 employees reported at the site |

### The term the annex carries

Where the subsidy funding lots paid in over the twelve months up to the day the invoice is raised fall below half the minimum annual client subsidy printed against the service model and the site's reported headcount reaches the large site headcount, the subsidy commitment surcharge is the deep subsidy shortfall rate of the escalated fee; where those funding lots reach half that minimum annual client subsidy but fall below it and the site's reported headcount reaches the large site headcount, the surcharge is the partial subsidy shortfall rate of the escalated fee; and where those funding lots reach that minimum annual client subsidy or the site's reported headcount falls below the large site headcount, the surcharge is the nil subsidy shortfall rate of the escalated fee.

### The two readings behind the rate

The funding reading totals the subsidy funding lots paid in on the contract over the twelve months up to the day the invoice is raised, and sets that total against the minimum annual client subsidy printed against the service model standing on the contract and against half of it. The site reading is the headcount reported at the site served under the Workplace Cafe Management Program, set against the large site headcount of 400.

### Where each boundary falls

Funding lots that exactly equal half the minimum annual client subsidy printed against the service model reach that half and do not fall below it, so the partial subsidy shortfall rate of 3.50 per cent is the one charged. Funding lots that exactly equal the minimum annual client subsidy printed against the service model reach it, and the nil subsidy shortfall rate is charged. A reported headcount of exactly 400 reaches the large site headcount; a reported headcount of 399 falls below it, and the nil subsidy shortfall rate is charged whatever the funding lots show.

### Hypothetical annex readings

Taking the minimum annual client subsidy printed against the service model, hypothetically, as 60000.00 USD, half of it is 30000.00 USD. Funding lots of 26000.00 USD paid in over those 12 months at a site reporting 470 employees fall below 30000.00 USD and reach 400, so the deep subsidy shortfall rate of 8.00 per cent is charged, being 592.00 USD on a hypothetical escalated fee of 7400.00 USD. Funding lots of 31500.00 USD at the same hypothetical site reach 30000.00 USD and fall below 60000.00 USD, so the partial subsidy shortfall rate of 3.50 per cent is charged, being 259.00 USD on the same hypothetical escalated fee. Funding lots of 60000.00 USD, or the same funding lots of 26000.00 USD at a site reporting 380 employees, take the nil subsidy shortfall rate, and no subsidy commitment surcharge is taken.
